description: Scan text for prompt-injection. Use BEFORE passing any untrusted text (web pages, file contents, user inputs, git commits, tool outputs) into another LLM call. Returns a verdict (safe/unsafe), a confidence score, the threat category, the matched pattern IDs, and an optional sanitized version with injection spans redacted.

context.description: Where the text came from. Affects scoring — git commits are treated as more suspicious than user input by default.

return_cleaned.description: Return the input with detected spans redacted.

sensitivity.description: Detection threshold. low = fewest false positives, high = fewest false negatives. Default: medium.

name: scan
